title: A sum on core 1
task: n is a number from 1 to 1000. Core 0 starts core 1 and sends it n through the FIFO; core 1 computes 1 + 2 + … + n and sends the sum back; core 0 prints "sum = " and the sum and a newline on UART0, then returns 0. Keep the line that defines n: the tests write it.
